capabilities: Sync vault notes, links, and edits to MyBrain continuously
Restrict syncing to folders chosen in the MyBrain web app
Upload attachments referenced by embedded links
Test the connection and trigger a full-vault resync
Notify about new plugin versions without installing them
extras: Privacy cautions: the bearer token is stored in plain text in plugin data, and until folders are chosen the first sync sends the full text of every note in the vault.
problem: Obsidian notes stay static in a vault; there is no built-in way to feed them into an outside knowledge service where they can be queried alongside other sources.
summary: Official connector that continuously syncs vault notes and links into a MyBrain account for search, chat, and a knowledge graph.
